entities.name: MasterInformationBlockSidelink message
entities.description: Sidelink master information block message containing synchronization and configuration parameters for NR sidelink communication.

entities.name: inCoverage
entities.description: Boolean field indicating whether UE is in coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication.

entities.name: sl-TDD-Config
entities.description: TDD configuration for sidelink communication, representing the same meaning as tdd-UL-DL-ConfigurationCommon.

entities.name: reservedBits
entities.description: Reserved bits field that may be set from syncInfoReserved or preconfigured parameters.

entities.name: In coverage condition
entities.description: UE is in coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication as defined in TS 38.304.

entities.name: Out of coverage with configuration condition
entities.description: UE is out of coverage and the frequency is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList or sl-FreqInfoList.

entities.name: Out of coverage with GNSS condition
entities.description: UE is out of coverage, selects GNSS as synchronization reference, and sl-SSB-TimeAllocation3 is not configured.

entities.name: Has SyncRef UE condition
entities.description: UE has a selected synchronization reference UE as defined in clause 5.8.6.

entities.name: Transmit MasterInformationBlockSidelink
entities.description: UE submits the MasterInformationBlockSidelink to lower layers for transmission.

relations.description: MasterInformationBlockSidelink message contains the inCoverage information element.
MasterInformationBlockSidelink message contains the sl-TDD-Config information element.
MasterInformationBlockSidelink message contains the reservedBits information element.
In coverage condition determines the value of inCoverage field.
Out of coverage with configuration condition determines the value of inCoverage field.
Out of coverage with GNSS condition determines the value of inCoverage field.
Has SyncRef UE condition determines the value of inCoverage field.
Transmission property establishes the submission of MasterInformationBlockSidelink to lower layers.
